name: reset_entry
note: docs/architecture.md: 0x200 TMSS check + table-driven hardware init

name: pad1_read_boot
note: writes $A10009/$A10003 and reads $A10003; no Z80 bus request (reset path)

name: attract_scroll
note: docs/architecture.md: $4E6 writes H-scroll values for the attract animation

name: game_dispatch
note: docs/architecture.md: $D25C game-code dispatcher (not the main loop itself)

name: vdp_ctrl_write
note: move.w arg;$C00004: one word to the VDP control port

name: vdp_data_write
note: move.w arg;$C00000: one word to the VDP data port

name: vdp_data_read
note: move.w $C00000;d0: one word from the VDP data port

name: vdp_set_write_addr
note: VDP control port: $4000|addr low word; then the 2-bit high part

name: pad1_read
note: bus request $A11100; TH select on $A10003; reads $A10003

name: pad2_read
note: bus request $A11100; TH select on $A10005; reads $A10005
